ExpanseMUD Wiki

A community reference for Expanse, a fantasy civilization simulation RPG in active development.

The wiki explains the worlds, gameplay systems, community, and creator tools using documented releases. Because the game is evolving, verify details against your installed game version.

Start here

  • Getting started — Install Expanse, begin a single-player adventure and manage saves.
  • People and the living world — NPC interactions, jobs, animals and singing.
  • Magic and combat — Spells, effects and character abilities.
  • Creator tools — Edit, export and share world content.
  • Multiplayer development — What is available now and what remains in development.
  • Community guidelines — Participation and moderation.

Official information

  • Official News & Server Status: The new staff announcements channel is under development. For now use the existing forum and the emergency status page below.
  • Emergency status page — A static fallback hosted outside the game service.
  • Official website — Current downloads, gameplay information and support links.

Suggest an improvement

Propose wiki corrections in the community forum's Suggestions & Feedback category. Wiki files are maintained in GitHub, with revisions and review before publication.

Expanse is independently created and transparently AI-assisted. Details may change between game versions.
